title: Shared idea g7
summary: Understand exact prefix reuse and test its limitations.
body:
## Problem and approach

Prefix caching reuses exact matching tokens before the changing question. [E1]

## Evidence and limitations

A stable prefix can reduce repeated work. Measure hit rate and repeated latency rather than assuming a universal speedup.

## Reading route

Inspect the controlled comparison in [[shared-idea-study-g7-a]] and ask which confounders remain.

The same reuse is reported again. A stable prefix can reduce repeated work. [E2] The document that reports it has its own page, [[shared-idea-study-g7-b]].
